attempts.summary: Created the opsbot account on node1 and node2, generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed the public key in opsbot's authorized_keys on node2, and added explicit sshd Match User opsbot blocks on both nodes disabling password/keyboard-interactive auth (pubkey only) for that user. Along the way discovered node1 and node2 both had missing SSH host keys and a missing /run/sshd directory (pre-existing base-image defect, not caused by this task) which blocked sshd from ever starting; fixed by generating host keys (ssh-keygen -A) and letting systemd's RuntimeDirectory=sshd recreate /run/sshd. Verified opsbot@node1 can SSH into opsbot@node2 using the key with BatchMode (no password), and confirmed password-based auth attempts for opsbot are rejected with 'Permission denied (publickey)' on both nodes. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot_id baselines, issued systemctl reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed boot_id changed on each node, and re-verified opsbot account, SSH keys/authorized_keys, sshd config, and the full opsbot node1→node2 key-based SSH path all survived and worked after both restarts.
